  "content": "import sys
import os


def test_win_is_true_on_msys2_mingw64(monkeypatch):
    """Simulate MSYS2 MINGW64 environment where sys.platform is 'win32'
    and sys.version contains 'GCC'. The WIN variable should be True so
    that Windows-specific code paths are used and tty is not imported."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "win32")
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "version", "3.10.5 (default, ...) [GCC 12.2.0]")
    # Remove cached module to force re-evaluation
    if "click._compat" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["click._compat"]
    import click._compat as compat
    assert compat.WIN is True


def test_win_is_true_on_standard_windows(monkeypatch):
    """Standard Windows Python without GCC in version string."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "win32")
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "version", "3.10.5 (tags/v3.10.5:f377153, Jun  6 2022, 16:14:13) [MSC v.1929 64 bit (AMD64)]")
    if "click._compat" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["click._compat"]
    import click._compat as compat
    assert compat.WIN is True


def test_win_is_false_on_cygwin(monkeypatch):
    """Cygwin environment should not be detected as Windows."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "cygwin")
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "version", "3.9.16 (default, ...) [GCC 11.4.0]")
    if "click._compat" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["click._compat"]
    import click._compat as compat
    assert compat.WIN is False


def test_win_is_false_on_linux(monkeypatch):
    """Linux environment should not be detected as Windows."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "linux")
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "version", "3.10.12 (main, Nov 20 2023, 15:14:05) [GCC 11.4.0]")
    if "click._compat" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["click._compat"]
    import click._compat as compat
    assert compat.WIN is False
